THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Cookies & Cream Cookie Creami

CrumblCreamiCut Week 8, Flavor 1 — vanilla protein Creami base, 3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies mixed in after the first spin, 10g Oreo dust on top. 350 cal / 42g protein whole pint. Deliberately classic — the point is it tastes exactly like cookies-and-cream should.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + 24 hr freeze + 5 min counter rest + 3 min spin + 2 min Respin + 1 min topping
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~350 cal | ~42g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Standard series base — 2% ultra-filtered milk, not fat-free. Some milk fat is intentional for texture.

Ingredients

CREAMI BASE

  • 1 cup 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 2 tbsp monk fruit sweetener
  • 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure)
  • 1 pinch salt
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

MIX-IN (added AFTER first spin)

  • 3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies (HighKey Original filmed, ~70 cal each)

POST-SCOOP TOPPING

  • 10 g Oreo crumbs / dust

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten, tree-nuts. TREE NUTS — HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies contain almond flour. Verify tree nut allergen status per current package if managing that allergen. Packaged labels vary — verify current HighKey sandwich cookie, Oreo crumb, and whey isolate labels before publishing final allergen or diet tags. Formulations drift. May contain soy + egg + additional tree nuts depending on sandwich cookie, Oreo, and whey isolate brands. Check the current package's allergen line if managing those allergens. Do not apply a gluten free tag — Oreo crumbs contain wheat.

You want a Crumbl Cookies & Cream Cookie whole-pint protein dessert — Week 8 Flavor 1 of CrumblCreamiCut, kickoff of Week 8. Same 1 cup 2% ultra-filtered milk + whey + guar + salt foundation as the series with 1 tsp vanilla extract as the base flavor carrier. Deliberately classic; the point is it tastes exactly like cookies-and-cream should. Score withheld — reserved for the Week 8 ranking video.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Combine 2% ultra-filtered milk + monk fruit sweetener + whey isolate + guar gum + salt + 1 tsp vanilla extract. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Vanilla extract is the base's whole flavor carrier this week — no cocoa, no berries, no emulsions.
  2. 2.POUR + FREEZE (24 HR). Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.
  3. 3.REST 5 MIN + FIRST SPIN. Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — no hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. The first spin should read as smooth vanilla; if it looks grainy, the Respin (with cookies) finishes the texture.
  4. 4.PORTION 3 COOKIES. Set aside 3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies (HighKey Original filmed, ~70 cal each). Whole cookies — don't crush ahead. The Respin does the breaking.
  5. 5.ADD 3 COOKIES + NO-LIQUID RESPIN. Drop all 3 sandwich cookies onto the spun pint. Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. The Respin breaks the cookies into pieces AND distributes them through the pint. NO liquid before Respin — this is the whole reason the cookies stay as chunks rather than dissolving.
  6. 6.RESPIN RESULT. The finished Respin should show visible cookie pieces distributed through the vanilla pint with a smooth, non-grainy Creami texture. If the texture still reads powdery, run one more Respin — still without adding liquid.
  7. 7.SCOOP. Scoop the finished pint into a bowl. Vanilla Creami with visible sandwich-cookie chunks pulled through.
  8. 8.OREO DUST + SERVE. Finish with 10 grams of Oreo crumbs / dust over the top. 10 g is the exact figure included in the 350-cal total — measure, don't eyeball. Serve immediately.

Keys to success

  • Level 1/8 tsp guar gum. Heaped = gummy.
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract is the base's whole flavor carrier this week. No cocoa, no berries, no emulsions, no Jell-O.

If something fails

Base is grainy after first spin: Expected — the Respin with the 3 sandwich cookies finishes the texture. Don't skip Respin because 'the base looks fine.'

Cookies disappeared / no visible pieces after Respin: Cookies broke too small. Next batch: keep cookies whole going into Respin (don't pre-crush). If pieces still pulverize, use larger cookies or Respin fewer cycles.

Cookies dissolved / turned to paste: Liquid was added before Respin. NO liquid before Respin on this method — the Creami is already cold enough to catch the cookies without extra moisture. Restart with a fresh pint if this happened.

Texture is powdery after Respin: Verify LEVEL 1/8 tsp guar gum. If still powdery, run one more Respin — no liquid.

Base reads too flat / not enough cookies-and-cream: Verify all 3 cookies went in (not 2). If still muted, add 1-2g more Oreo dust on top (adds ~5-10 cal, still within a 355-cal envelope).

Base reads too sweet: Monk fruit doses vary by brand. Filmed at 2 tbsp — pull to 1.5 tbsp for a mellower read.

Icy / hard texture: Verify 2% (not fat-free), LEVEL 1/8 tsp guar gum, 24 hr freeze upright and level, 5 min ROOM TEMP rest (no hot-water bath).

Oreo topping went soggy: Topping was added too early. Add the 10 g Oreo dust LAST, right before serving. Crunch holds for 2-3 minutes; serve immediately.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store the frozen pint upright and level in the freezer for up to 1 week pre-spin. Keep the sandwich cookies + Oreo crumbs at room temp per each package's guidance.

Reheat: N/A on the Creami. If re-serving from a frozen leftover Respin: room-temp rest 5 min + no-liquid Respin. Add fresh Oreo dust at the moment of serving; a topped pint held overnight goes soggy.

Lasts: Frozen pint (pre-spin) keeps 1 week. Spun Creami with cookie mix-in doesn't refreeze well; eat within 2-3 minutes of Respin + topping for peak crunch.

Flavor target

First spoon: vanilla protein Creami base with visible cookie pieces pulled through — cookies-and-cream identity from bite one. Middle: sandwich-cookie chunks hit as familiar Oreo-adjacent cookie crumb pockets from the no-liquid Respin. Top: 10g Oreo dust delivers the finishing chocolate-cookie cue. Whole pint should read as a classic cookies-and-cream ice cream — familiar, accessible, undefeated.

Crumbs / dust (10 g post-scoop topping)
